text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought the injured Verxina to the 
infirmary. Her initial first aid is 
complete.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry, Trainy. Thanks for 
carrying me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look, I'm not taking a break or anything! 
I still have other training routines to 
do...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm no good at sitting still! Besides, if 
I rest for days, I'll get rusty, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in the Dubai races. I 
know it's not going to be easy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've got no time to rest! I 
have to practice hard and get stronger!
choice_data_list:
For the sake of that dream, I want you to 
rest right now.

Okay, but if I think it's dangerous, we'll 
stop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I know how much she's 
staking on her dream, I can't risk seeing 
it cut short.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
But if I rest... Won't my goal get even 
further away...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that as long as the injury 
doesn't linger, she'll surely get there, 
and that I believe she has the strength to 
do it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I got it. I'll be patient. 
Because I believe in you, Trainie."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll study up on Dubai during my 
break, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos rested quietly and focused entirely 
on treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I know my own limits best♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Why the other leg too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Favoring an injury easily places extra 
strain on other parts of the body. That's 
likely how the opposite leg got hurt too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainy. I'm definitely going to 
wait until I'm all healed up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I can't run anymore, I won't be able to 
go to Dubai... I don't want that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos somehow accepted it. It looks like 
she'll need to rest quietly for a while...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I'm fine! I'm totally okay with 
this."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! I can't just sit around waiting 
to heal. There's plenty of things I can 
still do!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aim for Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To avoid putting too much strain on 
Vivlos's body, we shifted to lighter 
training for a while.
